objective: Commit a Waiting status before an effect updates it to Ready,with independent mounted state.

defects: Original only observed eventual Ready and missing Waiting,so static Ready and render-phase state updates passed.
Reference/junior status had no explicit role while senior already did.
Parent and independent/fresh mounted states were not observed.
rationale: Keep all three correct effect/state strategies. Make exactly one role=status element explicit;initial committed Waiting… becomes Ready! after the effect,without setting state in rendering. Add role=status to reference/junior and skeleton. A trusted parent useLayoutEffect observes the child committed DOM before passive effects;one visible and three hidden cases check the boundary,exact final status,12ordinary parent updates and independent/fresh initial states. Both static-ready and render-update controls genuinely pass the original suite and fail the final one. Six separate first-commit comparisons verify all original correct boards and an independent alternative against both wrong controls. Development Strict Mode repetition is explicitly outside a once-ever guarantee. No timer,AST restriction or complexity target is added.
